newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-TALLINNA APRIL PROFIT 5.1 MLN KROONS.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-TALLINNA APRIL PROFIT 5.1 MLN KROONS.

text.p: Tallinna Pank, the fourth largest bank in Estonia, had a net profit of 5.1 million kroons in April compared to 149,000 kroons in March, it said on Tuesday.
The undivided profit for 1997 was 23.9 million kroons at the end of April, it added in a statement.
The bank's assets grew by 38 million kroons or 1.8 percent to 2.18 billion kroons.
"The profit figure was as expected and came from traditional banking operations," the bank said in a statement.
Deposits grew 18.8 million kroons to 1.3 billion kroons despite the move by Tallinn city to put its deposits in rival Uhispank , the bank said.
The net loan portfolio was 1.25 billion kroons, up 30 million kroons from March.
